name: TaskNexus
description: Keeps TaskNexus in sync with the BotNexus agent registry by delivering per-agent webhook bindings on create, rename, and delete. Disabled until extensions.tasknexus.baseUrl is set.

configSchema.description: Base URL of the TaskNexus instance to notify. Absent means the extension makes no outbound call at all.
Externally reachable gateway origin TaskNexus should POST back to, prepended to the relative inbound webhook path.
